name: Amata City Run 2026
short_description: Amata City Run 2026 is on Sunday 1 November 2026 at Amata City Industrial Estate in Chon Buri, over 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: Amata City Run 2026 is organised by Amata Facility Services Co., Ltd. on the Tree Tunnel Road (Soi 1 Phitsuwan) beside the Amata Service Center in Amata City Industrial Estate, Chon Buri. The 21 km starts at 04:45 with a 2 hour 45 minute cut-off, followed by the 15 km, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km. Part of the income after costs goes to public-benefit organisations, and there are no age-group trophies.

core_facts.venue: Tree Tunnel Road (Soi 1 Phitsuwan), Amata City Industrial Estate

faqs.question: What are the start times and cut-offs at Amata City Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The 21 km starts at 04:45 with a 2 hour 45 minute cut-off, the 15 km at 05:20 (2 hours) and the 10 km at 05:30 (1.5 hours). The 5 km starts at 05:50 and the 3 km at 05:55, each with a one-hour cut-off.

faqs.question: Where do I collect my Amata City Run race kit?
faqs.answer: Race kits are collected on Friday 16 and Saturday 17 October 2026 from 09:30 to 17:00 on the ground floor of the Amata Service Center. Bring your registration confirmation and ID card; there is no kit collection on race day except for postal delivery errors.
